arStrings.szText: "I've caught a few fish for you. Strange enough?"
Aiya, I said “strange” fish! I could buy this rubbish from any fishmonger in Skovos! I need something unique. (sighs) The fish of my dreams.
Frustrated and dismissive, then dejected. He was really hoping the Player would find the fish.
Of course you don't. You see, I have lived a very long life, but I can’t remember a damn thing about it! (sighs) Not one single memory of who I am.
Deflated, dropping his guard. Confessing his secret.
But every night, I dream that I'm standing on this dock. Ah, the water is black and still, until the Fish breaks the surface. It stares at me...eyes shimmering like jewels!
(stammers) That little bastard knows who I am, I’m sure of it! You must expand your search... Fish the whole East, I don’t care—just bring me the most unique fish! One of them has to be him.
